limitations: Finite six-vertex counterexample and certified minimal order only. Not a classification of larger tree orders, nor a statement about independently resampled colour classes.
scientific_integrity: Exact exhaustive integer enumeration with two independent algorithms for six vertices and complete Pruefer enumeration for smaller orders. No simulations or infinite extrapolations. First public source date is the initial arXiv posting, not the later revision/journal publication. Historical priority remains contingent on wider literature review.
title: A six-vertex counterexample to path minimality for the first two greedy colour classes
